verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships its own server mode (`llama serve`), which a coding agent could plausibly use as a model backend. However, the evidence never documents an agent-compatible API, tool/function calling, or any hands-on report of connecting a coding agent to it. missing for 10: documented OpenAI-compatible or agent-facing API endpoint, tool-calling support, named coding-agent integration guides, independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend
